newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse ends 0.39 pct lower, volume up.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse ends 0.39 pct lower, volume up.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Wednesday closed down by 0.39 percent in higher trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 495.30 points, down from 497.23 on Tuesday.
Total volume was 1.68 million dinars against 1.04 million dinars over the previous session.
Over-the-counter exchanges amounted to 1.25 million dinars.
Cola and beer bottler SFBT fell 2.66 dinars to 87.34 dinars with only 20 shares changing hands. Retail stores Monoprix slid 0.96 dinar to 35.82 dinars.
Banque Nationale Agricole edged lower 0.87 dinar to 28.23 dinars. BNDT bank eased 0.81 dinar to 26.15.
Chemical firm Al-Kimia was down 0.5 dinar to 45.5. Chemical firm Industries Chimiques du Fluor declined 0.2 dinar to 56 dinars.
Detergent firm SPCD was up 0.64 dinar to 36.98 dinars. ($1=1.08 dinar)
